image_prompt.text: A colossal twisted dead tree looming above the swamp canopy, visible from anywhere in the biome so players can orient by it
Raised wooden plank walkways and bridges threading the swamp, linking patches of dry mossy ground across the water pools
Composed vantage points off the boardwalk looking out over the fog-covered pools and the glowing mushroom beds
Murky near-black swamp pools spread through the biome, stagnant and opaque, read as a barrier to cross rather than water to swim in
Twisted dead trees with bare clawed branches, hanging vines draped between them and trailing to the water
Clusters of glowing blue mushrooms lighting the ground, tree roots and pool edges
Moss-covered rocks and boulders scattered across the banks and shallows
Thick low-lying fog throughout and a palette of dark greens and purples, for a creepy atmosphere

notes: No genre: the prompt describes a place, a palette and a mood with no game type, so no-genre.md was loaded and no genre was invented for it.

would have asked: 'Sounds like an explorable place — a swamp you walk through on plank boardwalks over the pools, one huge dead tree as the landmark you navigate by, and a couple of composed viewpoints over the fog and glowing mushrooms. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?'

would have asked: whether the walkways are raised high enough to walk underneath. Built as a single-surface exterior with the planks sitting just above the water, which stays on the proven P0 route; genuine elevated catwalks with play space beneath would be P2, which is not ready yet — say the word and it can be noted for when it is.
would have asked: 'Anything else you want in the swamp?' (step 5 open question, unanswered).
CHECK comes from the water pools alone and is expected to pass: the water is a flat stagnant barrier nobody swims in, so the play volume does not self-occlude.
The fog and dark green/purple palette entry is atmosphere and material styling rather than segmentable geometry; segmentation should treat it as a global look instruction.
Preset caveat from no-genre.md: Explorable Place leaves every axis at its default and routes P0 on its own. No preset option was dropped and no shape was substituted.
